title: Body Blow (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
Best Director, Fantaspoa International Fantastic Film Festival
OUTshine LGBTQ+ Film Festival

 

Hong Kong Premiere

 

Danger and desire bleed into one another in this neon-soaked descent into Sydney's queer underworld. Disgraced cop Aiden is reassigned to the city's gay nightlife district, where a charged encounter with Cody, a seductive bartender and sex worker, pulls him into the orbit of a murderous drag-queen mob boss and a deadly heist. As obsession curdles into self-loathing, Aiden's repression spirals gloriously out of control. Writer-director Dean Francis resurrects the erotic thriller and refracts it through an unapologetically queer lens, shooting the grimy glamour of Oxford Street's legendary Stonewall Hotel with style to spare. Tim Pocock, Tom Rodgers and a menacing Paul Capsis lead this baroque crime story charged with lust and betrayal. Premiering at Fantastic Fest, BODY BLOW is this year’s campiest, sweatiest, and zaniest film yet.
